versions.changelog:
Initial release of manju-editor.

- Provides a comprehensive post-production guide for comic video editing.
- Includes detailed editing rules, transition types, voice reference library, BGM style recommendations, and subtitle standards.
- Specifies output formats and export parameters compatible with editing tools like JianYing.
- Designed for both standalone use (manual output schemes) and automatic invocation by manju-workflow.
- Serves as the single authoritative source for editing and synthesis rules.
